name: InVideo
summary: InVideo is an AI-powered video creation platform for marketers. It offers thousands of templates, stock assets, and automated tools to produce branded videos quickly.
description:
InVideo is an AI-powered video creation platform for marketers. It offers thousands of templates, stock assets, and automated tools to produce branded videos quickly.

5000+ customizable video templates. AI script generation from prompts. Premium stock video and music. Auto text-to-video from articles.

pricing.label: Freemium
pricing.note: Price label carried over from the previous catalog and not rechecked.

howToUse.title: Sign Up and Log In
howToUse.description: Register for a free or paid InVideo account. Log in to access the video creation dashboard.

howToUse.title: Choose a Template or Start from Scratch
howToUse.description: Browse thousands of templates by category, or start with a blank canvas for full creative control.

howToUse.title: Generate Script or Upload Content
howToUse.description: Use the AI script generator, input your own text, or convert articles into videos directly from a URL.

howToUse.title: Customize Video
howToUse.description: Edit scenes, add stock footage, music, text, transitions, and branding elements. Use drag-and-drop tools for quick adjustments.

howToUse.title: Preview and Export
howToUse.description: Preview your video for quality and accuracy. Export it in your desired format and resolution, or publish directly to social platforms.
